mapper.select: WITH RECURSIVE approval_categories AS ( SELECT a.approval_id, category.merchant_category_id, category.parent_id, category.category_code FROM card_payment_approvals a INNER JOIN merchants merchant ON merchant.merchant_id = a.merchant_id INNER JOIN merchant_categories category ON category.merchant_category_id = merchant.merchant_category_id WHERE a.approval_id IN #{approvalId} UNION ALL SELECT child.approval_id, parent.merchant_category_id, parent.parent_id, parent.category_code FROM approval_categories child INNER JOIN merchant_categories parent ON parent.merchant_category_id = child.parent_id ) SELECT a.approval_id, a.user_card_id, a.amount, a.approved_at, mc.category_code AS merchant_category_code, m.merchant_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT lineage.category_code ORDER BY lineage.category_code) AS merchant_category_codes, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT lineage.merchant_category_id ORDER BY lineage.merchant_category_id) AS merchant_category_ids FROM card_payment_approvals a LEFT JOIN merchants m ON m.merchant_id = a.merchant_id AND m.status = 'active' LEFT JOIN merchant_categories mc ON mc.merchant_category_id = m.merchant_category_id LEFT JOIN approval_categories lineage ON lineage.approval_id = a.approval_id WHERE a.approval_id IN #{approvalId} GROUP BY a.approval_id, a.user_card_id, a.amount, a.approved_at, mc.category_code, m.merchant_id
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM user_benefit_calculation_outcomes WHERE approval_id IN #{approvalId} AND usage_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), 'UTC', 'Asia/Seoul'), '%Y-%m-01')
DELETE FROM user_benefit_usages WHERE approval_id IN #{approvalId} AND usage_date >= DATE_FORMAT(CONVERT_TZ(UTC_TIMESTAMP(), 'UTC', 'Asia/Seoul'), '%Y-%m-01')
mapper.select: SELECT r.rule_id, o.offer_id, o.offer_name, o.reward_type, r.reward_unit, r.reward_value, r.reward_basis_amount, r.previous_spend_min_krw, r.transaction_min_krw, r.transaction_max_krw, CAST(r.rule_definition_json AS CHAR) AS rule_definition_json, r.rule_support_status, t.target_type, CASE t.target_type WHEN 'merchant_category' THEN t.merchant_category_id WHEN 'merchant' THEN t.merchant_id ELSE t.target_code END AS target_code, t.condition_group, t.match_mode FROM user_cards uc INNER JOIN card_content_versions cv ON cv.card_id = uc.card_id AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM card_content_versions newer WHERE newer.card_id = cv.card_id AND (newer.last_seen_at > cv.last_seen_at OR (newer.last_seen_at = cv.last_seen_at AND newer.content_version_id > cv.content_version_id)) ) INNER JOIN card_benefits cb ON cb.content_version_id = cv.content_version_id INNER JOIN benefit_offers o ON o.benefit_id = cb.benefit_id INNER JOIN benefit_rules r ON r.offer_id = o.offer_id INNER JOIN benefit_rule_targets t ON t.rule_id = r.rule_id WHERE uc.user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND r.rule_effect = 'grant' AND r.stacking_mode = 'standalone' AND o.reward_type IN ('discount', 'cashback', 'points') AND r.reward_unit IN ('percent', 'KRW', 'point', 'mile') AND t.target_type IN ('all_merchants', 'merchant_category', 'merchant') AND (r.valid_from IS NULL OR r.valid_from <= #{usageDate}) AND (r.valid_to IS NULL OR r.valid_to >= #{usageDate}) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM benefit_rule_targets unsafe WHERE unsafe.rule_id = r.rule_id AND unsafe.target_type NOT IN ( 'all_merchants', 'merchant_category', 'merchant')) AND ( (r.rule_definition_json IS NOT NULL AND r.rule_support_status IN ('SUPPORTED', 'PARTIAL')) OR (r.rule_definition_json IS NULL AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM benefit_rule_schedules s WHERE s.rule_id = r.rule_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM benefit_offer_option_requirements req WHERE req.offer_id = o.offer_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM benefit_limit_policies p WHERE p.offer_id = o.offer_id AND (p.limit_period <> 'monthly' OR p.limit_type <> 'reward_amount' OR p.limit_unit NOT IN ('KRW', 'point', 'mile')))) ) ORDER BY r.priority DESC, r.rule_id, t.condition_group, t.target_id
SELECT user_card_id FROM user_cards WHERE user_card_id = #{userCardId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT p.limit_policy_id, p.shared_group_key, t.limit_value, t.previous_spend_min_krw, t.current_spend_min_krw, CAST(p.applicable_months_json AS CHAR) AS applicable_months_json FROM benefit_limit_policies p INNER JOIN benefit_limit_tiers t ON t.limit_policy_id = p.limit_policy_id WHERE p.offer_id = #{offerId} AND p.limit_period = 'monthly' AND p.limit_type = 'reward_amount' AND p.limit_unit = #{limitUnit} AND (p.shared_group_key IS NULL OR p.shared_group_key NOT LIKE 'OFFER:%') AND (p.valid_from IS NULL OR p.valid_from <= #{usageDate}) AND (p.valid_to IS NULL OR p.valid_to >= #{usageDate}) ORDER BY t.position

SELECT CASE WHEN #{limitUnit} = 'KRW' THEN ubu.reward_amount_krw ELSE COALESCE(ubu.reward_original_value, 0) END FROM user_benefit_usages ubu INNER JOIN benefit_limit_policies used_policy ON used_policy.limit_policy_id = ubu.limit_policy_id WHERE ubu.user_card_id = #{userCardId} AND ubu.usage_status = 'confirmed' AND ubu.usage_date >= #{usageMonthStart} AND ubu.usage_date < #{nextMonthStart} AND ((#{sharedGroupKey} IS NULL AND ubu.limit_policy_id = #{limitPolicyId}) OR (#{sharedGroupKey} IS NOT NULL AND used_policy.shared_group_key = #{sharedGroupKey})) FOR UPDATE

SELECT t.limit_value FROM benefit_limit_policies p INNER JOIN benefit_limit_tiers t ON t.limit_policy_id = p.limit_policy_id WHERE p.offer_id = #{offerId} AND p.limit_period = 'monthly' AND p.limit_type = 'reward_amount' AND p.limit_unit = #{limitUnit} AND p.shared_group_key = CONCAT('OFFER:', #{offerId}) AND (p.valid_from IS NULL OR p.valid_from <= #{usageDate}) AND (p.valid_to IS NULL OR p.valid_to >= #{usageDate}) AND (t.previous_spend_min_krw IS NULL OR t.previous_spend_min_krw <= #{previousMonthSpend}) ORDER BY COALESCE(t.previous_spend_min_krw, 0) DESC, t.position DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user_benefit_usages ( usage_id, user_card_id, offer_id, rule_id, limit_policy_id, approval_id, usage_date, eligible_amount_krw, reward_amount_krw, reward_original_value, reward_original_unit, usage_count, usage_status, approved_at, confirmed_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{usageId}, #{userCardId}, #{offerId}, #{ruleId}, #{limitPolicyId}, #{approvalId}, #{usageDate}, #{eligibleAmountKrw}, #{rewardAmountKrw}, #{rewardOriginalValue}, #{rewardOriginalUnit}, 1, 'confirmed', #{approvedAt}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE usage_id = usage_id

INSERT INTO user_benefit_calculation_outcomes ( outcome_id, user_card_id, approval_id, offer_id, rule_id, limit_policy_id, usage_date, reward_unit, expected_reward_value, applied_reward_value, missed_reward_value, outcome_status, rejection_reason, calculated_at, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{outcomeId}, #{userCardId}, #{approvalId}, #{offerId}, #{ruleId}, #{limitPolicyId}, #{usageDate}, #{rewardUnit}, #{expectedRewardValue}, #{appliedRewardValue}, #{missedRewardValue}, #{outcomeStatus}, #{rejectionReason}, UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), UTC_TIMESTAMP(6) ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE outcome_id = outcome_id
